WoW: Forever

Affliction Warlock

Stacked shadow damage-over-time spells plus channelled drains, "for players who enjoy watching their enemies slowly rot away."

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Affliction build has been tested. Talent tiers unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. No source has posted a level 30 build either: the cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below therefore extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs — not a build any guide has recommended.

What Affliction is for

Timed damage that keeps paying out while you do something else. Improved CorruptionImproved CorruptionTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%. 5/5 makes CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec. instant from level 14, and in Forever those ticks can critically strike. PandemicPandemicTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%. from 22 doubles the critical damage of CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec., both Banes, Siphon LifeSiphon LifeLevel 30 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost150 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration30 secTransfers 11 health from the target to the caster every 3 sec. Lasts 30 sec. and both Drains. Your damage keeps landing while you move, wand or Life TapLife TapSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledReduces health cost of your Life Tap by 12%..

"Affliction Warlocks have always been excellent levelers, and that strength shows up early in WoW Forever… Learning how to balance those tools lets you move through enemies with very little downtime." Icy Veins rates its levelling 5 out of 5, joint best in the class.

Its weakness is short fights, and two sources say so: "Affliction performs best when enemies live long enough for your DoTs to ramp up. Fast dungeon pulls can end before that setup has time to pay off." Another source puts it bluntly: "On a target that dies in ten seconds, you paid full mana and cast time for half a spell's worth of damage."

Icy Veins' dungeon score for it is 4.0, against 5.0 for levelling.

Learn to stop casting when your existing damage-over-time effects will finish the job.

Rotation

Icy Veins and Wowhead order the opening DoTs differently, and both give a reason.

Icy Veins' order (Immolate, then Corruption, then Bane of Agony) leads with the DoT that pays off fastest.

Wowhead reverses it, Bane of Agony first, Corruption, Immolate last, arguing threat: "Bane of Agony first: it deals the least upfront damage, so it's the least threat and requires time to build up to full damage. Immolate last; its initial Hit generates direct threat, so it's the worst opener."

  1. Send the demon in first
  2. If the pack dies fast, skip the effects and go straight to Rain of Fire.

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Intellect, Spirit, critical strike, Stamina, Haste.

Two of those placements are Forever-specific. Spirit is high because "Life TapLife TapSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledReduces health cost of your Life Tap by 12%. has changed and now scales off of your Spirit." Critical strike matters "much more than it was in original Classic" because damage-over-time effects can now crit. Haste is last: it "did not make DoTs or Drain channels tick faster."

Your demon

All four come from class quests: Imp at 2, VoidwalkerVoidwalkerSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost32 ManaCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration180 secSummons 1 Voidwalker to aid the caster in battle for 180 sec. at 10, Succubus at 20, Felhunter at 30.

VoidwalkerVoidwalkerSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost32 ManaCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration180 secSummons 1 Voidwalker to aid the caster in battle for 180 sec. is the levelling pet: "your tanky option and the best option to use once you unlock it." It "can literally face tank multiple enemies, while you DoT them all up." Its threat comes from TormentTormentTalent · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost20 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown5 sec cooldownTaunts the creature, increasing the chance that it will attack the Voidwalker., which Wowhead notes is noticeably weaker until rank 2 trains at 20. Succubus "deals insanely high damage compared to the other available demons."

Forever trains the Felhunter at 30. In Classic it came from a quest that opened at 30 and withheld Spell Lock until 36.

Both MalevolenceMalevolenceTalentCastInstantYour damage spells have a chance to cause your target to take up to 50 increased damage from subsequent spells. and PandemicPandemicTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Corruption, Bane of Agony, Bane of Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, and Wrack spells by 100%. are new talents built on it.

At level 60

Unknown, and one guide says why: "Critical striking DoTs, Pandemic, Wrack, Improved Drains, and the new Drain Soul execute bonuses all scale together in ways that cannot easily be evaluated from a Level 38 build."

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
